newsitem.title: USA: Photographer sues Tommy Lee over pushing incident.
newsitem.headline: Photographer sues Tommy Lee over pushing incident.

text.p: A photographer who claimed he was injured trying to snap a picture of rocker Tommy Lee and his wife, Baywatch star Pamela Lee Anderson, sued the drummer on Tuesday for assault and negligence.
Lee already faces a misdemeanor charge of battery with serious injury following the Oct. 15 incident outside the trendy Hollywood nightclub, the Viper Room.
The photographer Henry Trappler alleges Lee attacked him and pushed him to the ground, causing him to fracture a rib and his pelvis.
At a news conference on Tuesday, Trappler's lawyer Gloria Allred played a videotape taken by another cameraman of the alleged incident.
It allegedly showed Lee, drummer with the group Motley Crue, fling Trappler to the ground and swear at him.

Lee is scheduled to be arraigned on the misdemeanor battery charge on Nov. 12, but Allred said she had written to California Attorney General Dan Lungren asking him to explain why the District Attorney's office had not pressed a felony assault charge against Lee.
"The answer is obvious to many people. Mr (Los Angeles D.A. Gil) Garcetti has a two-tier system of justice -- one for celebrities and one for the rest of the people," Allred said in her letter.
Trappler's suit accuses Lee of assault and battery, negligence and interference with the exercise of his civil rights. The suit does not specify any amount of damages.
